name: Ob Nixilis
aliases: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath
description: Ob Nixilis is a demon and planeswalker, once a conquest-obsessed human warlord, who schemes to regain his spark and later appears as the Adversary on New Capenna.

timeline.summary: The Great Barrier fails, the Guilds fall, and new nations rise; Ob Nixilis comes for the Chain Veil and is cursed.
timeline.quote: At some point, Ob Nixilis came for the Chain Veil and was cursed by its power.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Fall of the guilds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri desparks Ob Nixilis with a hedron and traps him on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: desparks Nixilis with a hedron and traps him on Zendikar

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The hooded oracle is revealed to be Ob Nixilis, who thanks the party for assembling the hedron.
timeline.quote: The figure throws off the cloak—it's Ob Nixilis, the dreaded demon.

citation.text: "Booster Quest!". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The party strikes down Ob Nixilis and reseals the hedron in the crypt.
timeline.quote: You strike down Ob Nixilis, who disappears in a haze of black mana.

citation.text: "Booster Quest!". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kozilek emerges from deep underground after Ob Nixilis drains the hedron network imprisoning Ulamog.
timeline.quote: Kozilek emerged from deep underground nearby.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri binds Ob Nixilis's power with a hedron before he can do much damage.
timeline.quote: Nahiri intervened and bound his power with that of a hedron

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Guarding Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: More than a thousand years ago, Ob Nixilis summons demons who kill every living thing on his plane, and his spark ignites.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis's spark ignited while he walked away from his dead plane

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Conqueror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis acquires the Chain Veil on Shandalar, which curses him into a demon.
timeline.quote: but it cursed him and turned him into a demon.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Conqueror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri intercepts Ob Nixilis on Zendikar and fuses a hedron into his forehead, binding his spark and trapping him.
timeline.quote: This hedron bound his spark , trapping him on the plane

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Trapped". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace takes Nixilis's lure, strikes him down and extracts the hedron to save Garruk, restoring Nixilis's strength.
timeline.quote: Thus Ob Nixilis regained his strength and could regrow his wings.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Trapped". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace halts Garruk's chain veil curse by implanting a hedron in him.
timeline.quote: Jace succeeded in implanting the hedron in Garruk and halting the curse of the chain veil.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Unfinished Business". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis broods over his two defeats, the first taking his body and the second his spark, and the folly of seeking the Veil.
timeline.quote: The first robbed me of my body. The second of my spark.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Deep underground, Ob Nixilis rotates the hedrons on the cavern walls and casts spells, testing their runes.
timeline.quote: He rotated a hedron a few degrees and spoke a brief incantation.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
timeline.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ob Nixilis was drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse but was attacked and bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped his curse but crippled him.
timeline.quote: I couldn't even scream as she bound the hedron into me.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As the passage crushes in around him, Ob Nixilis drains the stone's vitality and digs toward a green glow.
timeline.quote: He bought himself a moment by bracing himself between the walls, and he muttered a spell.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reveals that the bound hedron took his power and that his wings fell off, leaving him small and weak, and vows revenge.
timeline.quote: The thing she put inside me made me small. Weak.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis studies the hedrons for centuries and lures planeswalkers, letting word of his condition spread until a proud planeswalker comes to extract the hedron.
timeline.quote: And sure enough, some arrogant child finally took my lure.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reaches the glowing source in the depths and takes a flower of green and gold power from a tiny sphere of life, laughing.
timeline.quote: It radiated power, warmth, and health.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.
timeline.quote: My spark is within reach.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane finds the Khalni Heart in the devastated continent, defeats Ob Nixilis, and escapes with the Heart.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped.

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers facing the Eldrazi, while Ob Nixilis seeks a way off the plane.
timeline.quote: Now, Gideon Jura takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers in facing the Eldrazi alongside the residents of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis summons Kozilek and defeats Jace, Nissa and Gideon, capturing and torturing them until Chandra frees them.
timeline.quote: He summoned Kozilek and defeated Jace, Nissa, and Gideon.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis frees Kozilek and reignites his spark.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis used his newfound power to coax the second Eldrazi Titan, Kozilek, from its hiding spot

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis captures and tortures Gideon, Jace and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis then took Gideon, Jace, and Nissa prisoner, took them to a cave, and tortured them.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra frees her friends and scares Ob Nixilis away.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar showed up and freed her friends.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa beats Ob Nixilis at the Khalni Heart and escapes with it and the revived Ashaya.
timeline.quote: Flush with the elemental power of Zendikar, Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped with the revived Ashaya.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reignites his spark with the hedron magic and escapes Zendikar.
timeline.quote: which reignited his planeswalker's spark and allowed him to escape from Zendikar

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis coaxes Kozilek out from under the plane's crust.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis used his newfound power to coax the second Eldrazi Titan, Kozilek, from its hiding spot under the plane's crust.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa bests Ob Nixilis at Bala Ged and removes the Khalni Heart to safety.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Tazeem Ob Nixilis siphons the hedron network, reigniting his spark, destroys it and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: he destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis defeats Nissa and breaks Jace's cheekbone at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the demon's glancing blow broke Jace's cheekbone and sent him sprawling.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon shreds one of the demon's wings; Nixilis pins and drowns him in muddy water.
timeline.quote: Nixilis then proved that invulnerability was nothing as he proceeded to drown Gideon in the muddy waters at their feet.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nixilis takes Gideon, Jace and Nissa prisoner and tortures them until Chandra frees them and their attack scares him away from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Their concerted attack managed to scare the demon away from Zendikar

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ulamog is trapped, but Ob Nixilis disrupts the network, freeing Ulamog and waking Kozilek.
timeline.quote: the demon planeswalker Ob Nixilis appeared and disrupted the network, leaving Ulamog to ravage the city and waking Kozilek as well.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
timeline.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis knocks the hedrons out of alignment and reignites his spark.
timeline.quote: Everything looked to be smooth sailing until Ob Nixilis arrived, knocked the hedrons out of alignment, and positioned himself between them.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis slaughters the Kor guards, siphons the hedrons' power to reignite his spark, destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: he destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis wakes buried alive after Nissa took Khalni Heart and collapsed the cavern on him.
timeline.quote: She left me alive.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis weighs his options and decides he must save Zendikar to buy time to rebuild his work.
timeline.quote: I was going to have to save Zendikar.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He digs himself out over days, finding Bala Ged stripped of life so there is nothing to drain.
timeline.quote: The entire process of escape took days.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He recovers the keystone hedron of his network and uses it to sense where the last stand will be.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate, if memory served. A lovely place for a slaughter.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis flies to Tazeem and Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: I unfurled my wings.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
timeline.quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He flies above the battle and locks his keystone hedron above the ring's center, tapping the network's energy.
timeline.quote: I willed it into place, locked it into a harmonic point above the ring's precise center.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis's spark returns and he feels the Multiverse again.
timeline.quote: My spark returned.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
timeline.quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He unleashes a bolt of annihilation on the armies, cutting off their retreat and forcing them toward Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I let loose an enormous bolt of withering annihilation into the armies below

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reaches out to an awakening power deep beneath the surface to the south and calls it to rise.
timeline.quote: Awakened it fully with the sheer force of my will.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds the Khalni Heart in Bala Ged, restores her connection to Zendikar and defeats Ob Nixilis.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis , removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and left the demon seething underground.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis arrives and knocks the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis knocked the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his Planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra leaves Keral Keep for Zendikar and finds Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.
timeline.quote: she left the Keep for Zendikar...only to find Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa recognizes the demon from Bala Ged as the cause of the collapse as he casts a great spell.
timeline.quote: He was the cause of all of this.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis calls a second titan, Kozilek, up from the ground.
timeline.quote: The demon had called yet another horror to ravage her world.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa surrenders to rage and runs at the demon through Kozilek's distortion and the toppling lighthouse.
timeline.quote: Kozilek's flailing arm had smashed into the seawall

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa tackles Ob Nixilis with her blade at his neck, but he escapes and drains her with essence magic.
timeline.quote: sending a tide of his essence-draining magic down at Nissa.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis uses spawn of Kozilek to cut Nissa off from Zendikar and the leylines.
timeline.quote: She was cut off from Zendikar. Powerless.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis senses a telepath in his head and strikes down Jace, breaking his cheekbone.
timeline.quote: my fist broke his cheekbone instead of taking his head off as I'd intended.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears Ob Nixilis's wing and confronts him, declaring the people under his protection.
timeline.quote: These people are under my protection, demon.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Ob Nixilis fight, and Ob Nixilis breaks the telepath's confidence in Gideon and kills six stragglers.
timeline.quote: Six dead.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon breaks Ob Nixilis's knee with a joint lock, but the demon pins him.
timeline.quote: The knee cracked and a sickening jolt pulsed through my body.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis drowns Gideon in muddy water, and Gideon's body goes limp.
timeline.quote: Invulnerability proved no match for three inches of dirty water.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at the Battle for Zendikar and frees Gideon, Jace and Nissa from Ob Nixilis, scaring the demon off.
timeline.quote: She managed to free them, and through a concerted attack they finally scared the demon away from the plane.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Nissa imprison Ulamog in a hedron network at Sea Gate on Ugin's advice, but Ob Nixilis's interference makes it fail and he calls Kozilek to join Ulamog.
timeline.quote: That effort was briefly successful but ultimately failed due to interference by Ob Nixilis

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis traps Gideon, Jace, and Nissa while seeking the Eldrazi's power; Chandra frees them and they drive him from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar arrived in time to free her fellow planeswalkers, and together they forced Ob Nixilis to flee Zendikar.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Jace trap Ulamog with the hedrons until Ob Nixilis destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: He destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds and frees Nissa, Jace and Gideon from Ob Nixilis's cave.
timeline.quote: Luckily, Chandra Nalaar had arrived on Zendikar, found the trio, and freed them.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa join forces against the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek and the planeswalker Ob Nixilis, becoming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: They become the Gatewatch , a team with a lasting commitment to protect the people of the Multiverse from threats that no one else can handle.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra frees her friends, they scare Ob Nixilis from Zendikar and swear an oath, creating the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus, they swore an oath to stand together, and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
timeline.quote: The demon took him, and two others.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
timeline.quote: I'm inviting myself,

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The demon overpowers Chandra, drains her fire and mimics her parents' voices to make her give up.
timeline.quote: You've failed them, Chandra. Just like you failed us .

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
timeline.quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
timeline.quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's fire cyclone blasts the demon, who promises revenge across the planes and vanishes.
timeline.quote: The air folded in on itself, swallowing the demon, and he was gone.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
timeline.quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Cut off from the earth, Nissa recalls her only other equal isolation, when Ob Nixilis tore Ashaya from her (flashback).
timeline.quote: when the demon Ob Nixilis had disrupted the ley lines on Zendikar and torn Ashaya from her

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge; Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeat him, and Hazoret gives them her spear.
timeline.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear, reassuring Samut about the condition of Amonkhet's population

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack distracts Tezzeret so Karn can destroy the Bridge control mechanism, collapsing the portal.
timeline.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn flies an explosive micro-drone into Tezzeret's chest, collapsing the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

citation.text: "Karn", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis is lured to Ravnica and trapped by the Immortal Sun, absorbing the souls of Eternals he kills.
timeline.quote: He absorbed the souls of the Eternals he killed, fueling his power.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nixilis joins Karn, Dack and Samut to go through the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet; Karn destroys the Bridge mechanism in Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nixilis incinerates the inactive Eternals and, uninterested in Hazoret's fight against Bolas, planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Refusing to go back to the battle on Ravnica, he planeswalked away to safety.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden, Ob Nixilis, Karn and Samut travel to Amonkhet and shut off the portal.
timeline.quote: traveled to Amonkhet and shut it off

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, Nixilis, Dack and Samut go through Bolas's Planar Bridge to Amonkhet to shut it from the other side.
timeline.quote: Karn , Ob Nixilis , Dack Fayden , and Samut volunteered to go through Bolas' Planar Bridge to Amonkhet and shut the portal down from the other side.

citation.text: "Samut", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Adversary, revealed as Ob Nixilis, learns what the Font is and toasts to taking over the plane at the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Here's to taking over the plane."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander sends Anhelo out the receiving door, sensing enemies are close, and then confronts the Adversary in the shadows.
timeline.quote: "Have you finally come to kill me, Adversary?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander's former assassins turn on him in the museum and he kills several with his cane-blade before retreating.
timeline.quote: Xander grabbed it, slashing through the air and sending a spray of ash across the room.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander flees to the viewing deck and duels the Adversary, who lands behind him.
timeline.quote: "Did you really think you could escape me?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary blasts Xander with magic and Xander falls from Park Heights into the clouds below.
timeline.quote: His foot met open air, and he plummeted into the clouds below.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary's infiltrators reveal themselves at the Crescendo; revelers throw off their family signets and draw weapons, and the Halo bottle is dropped.
timeline.quote: No family was exempt from infiltration by the Adversary.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis revels over Xander's mutilated body, and a Maestro informs him that the Font escaped the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "The Font escaped."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis learns another unaccounted person aided the escape, realizes Xander played him, and vows to find the Font.
timeline.quote: Even from beyond the grave, Xander had played him.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Officers report Jetmir gravely wounded, the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised; Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
timeline.quote: "I want the families' heads. All of them.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth finds the museum overrun, overhears that she is the Adversary's target number one, and takes a sword from the armory.
timeline.quote: "The Adversary has deemed her as target number one

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis arrives at the cathedral with enforcers; Vivien fires on him and Elspeth fights him but is thrown back.
timeline.quote: "Good of you to show yourself, Ob Nixilis."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada transforms into the radiant magic of Halo, blasting Ob Nixilis away and giving Elspeth strength.
timeline.quote: Giada was transformed into the radiant magic of Halo.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wounds Ob Nixilis's neck with the new sword, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: In a blink, he was gone, having planeswalked away.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo, killing Xander and mortally wounding Jetmir; Giada's sacrifice awakens the angels.
timeline.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir mortally wounded.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Giada sacrifices herself to rearm Elspeth, who wounds Nixilis with Luxior.
timeline.quote: she was able to strike a deadly blow against Nixilis, forcing him to planeswalk away to safety.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis infiltrates the plane and strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo; Xander is killed and Jetmir wounded.
timeline.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir seriously wounded.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the night of the Cabaretti Crescendo, Ob Nixilis has his agents attack all five families of New Capenna and kills Xander himself.
timeline.quote: Nixilis himself traveled to the Maestro Museum, killing the family's leader, Xander , personally.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis follows Elspeth, Vivien and the Font to a Park Heights cathedral, is badly wounded and flees.
timeline.quote: he nearly overcame Tirel before being badly wounded and planeswalking away to safety.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis sits out the New Phyrexian Invasion, then loses his spark and is stranded on New Capenna.
timeline.quote: Nixilis is now stranded on New Capenna, at the mercy of the five families wanting revenge.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Return to New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Crescendo, Vivien rescues Elspeth and Giada during the Adversary's attack.
timeline.quote: Vivien arrived at the venue in time to rescue Elspeth and her companion Giada

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In his pursuit of power, an ancient magical artifact transforms the human warlord Ob Nixilis into a demon.
timeline.quote: In his pursuit of power, an ancient magical artifact transformed him into a demon.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis, after first seeking to remove the curse, embraces his new form and its power.
timeline.quote: he eventually embraced his new form and the power it gave him.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Nahiri attacked and bound a hedron into him; he swears revenge.
relations.quote: And for that, one day, I will have my revenge.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

relations.note: Nissa took Khalni Heart and buried him.
relations.quote: Nissa took Khalni Heart from the demon would-be Planeswalker

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

relations.note: Nissa defeated Ob Nixilis and took the Khalni Heart.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

relations.note: Nissa swears to end the demon.
relations.quote: For that, and for everything else, she would end him.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

relations.quote: Steel met flesh, and she grazed off the side of his neck.
